due_when.clears_when: The PR opened for claude/w5d-bot-pr-ci (or the next bot-opened PR after it merges) carries more than one check run attached to its FIRST head -- i.e. more than just claude-pr-automerge's own open-and-automerge job -- without needing a follow-up push. Verified by reading check runs on that PR's initial commit via the GitHub API, not by reading this diff.

origin.ref: claude/fix-m20-sweep-empty-result lane (session_01Ja2uqCC7mPi3n3dP2BhgT3) -- observed while landing PR #13001 (records-file fix) and PR #13003 (RQ-003/004 dispatch stamp); PR #13000 is a second, independent instance from a different lane the same day.
origin.rerun: gh api repos/benbaichmankass/Metis-Insights/commits/<PR-opening-commit-sha>/check-runs --jq '.check_runs[] | {name, status, conclusion}' -- on an affected PR this returns only the automerge workflow's own runs (or action_required conclusions) for the PR-opening commit; compare against the SAME query on the commit from any subsequent authenticated push on the same PR, which returns full pull_request-event runs with real conclusions.

terminal_reason: BACKLOG-BURNDOWN 2026-10-04: Bot-opened PRs now get full CI checks: #13048 merged, #16427/#16417 carry 4 check runs.
what: A PR opened by the claude-pr-automerge workflow (using its own GITHUB_TOKEN, not a push from an authenticated human/session actor) never gets its pull_request-triggered CI (Guards, pytest-collect, pytest-run, repo-inventory) to actually run on the PR-opening commit -- those checks come back either 'action_required' (needing manual approval) or, in a second observed shape, simply never start at all (mergeable_state stays blocked with no check runs beyond the automerge workflow's own 'watch'/'open-and-automerge'). MEASURED twice: PR #13000 (branch fix-leg-flow-expiry-prompted) and PR #13003 (branch claude/stamp-rq-003-004-dispatch) both hit this on their PR-opening commit; both were unstuck only by a SUBSEQUENT push from an authenticated actor (a human/session git push, not the bot token) triggering a real pull_request synchronize event. On PR #13001 the same shape appeared on its first commit (7077d9e1, opened by github-actions[bot], conclusion action_required across pytest-collect/Guards/repo-inventory/pytest-run) and resolved cleanly once a follow-up commit (df4e7c5f) was pushed by an authenticated actor -- three instances total, all following the identical shape. ROOT-CAUSED 2026-09-27 (session_011iMMUzhVQ1UPBzd8WfXa6C, lane dispatched by manager session_01Ljhs6sFAdWHdMDhJpL5aBP; sign-off for the CI-auth change at MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json row R4 'OPERATOR DECISIONS 2026-09-27' item (4)): BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN IS set on this repo -- confirmed by reading the job log for PR #13027's opening push (run 36279095114 / job 108498515118): patToken was truthy (no 'BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN is NOT set' warning). The PAT client construction (`require('@actions/github').getOctokit(patToken)`, with an `__original_require__` escape attempted first) threw `Cannot find module '@actions/github'` on that run -- that module is not resolvable from a github-script@v7 user script -- and the code caught it, warned, and silently fell back to opening the PR under GITHUB_TOKEN EVERY TIME, which is why every affected PR (#13000, #13003, #13018, #13019, #13021, #13027) shows the identical shape regardless of the token being present. FIX (branch claude/w5d-bot-pr-ci, not yet merged): the PAT-authenticated PR-open call now uses the runtime's own global `fetch` for a direct REST POST instead of an Octokit client -- one call needs no client, so there is no module to fail to resolve. No new trust: same BRANCH_PROTECTION_TOKEN secret, same single call it already existed to make; only the mechanism to use it was repaired. Also updated automerge-trigger-guard C6's source assertion and its test suite (tests/test_automerge_pat_client_fallback.py, tests/test_automerge_request_gate.py) to match. This PR touches R12's LANDING_MACHINERY (the workflow + both CI guard scripts it edits), so it holds for a human merge rather than self-landing (.github/pr-landing/w5d-bot-pr-ci.json). NOT YET OBSERVED: whether the fix actually works against the real GitHub API once this PR's own branch is pushed and claude-pr-automerge.yml (using this branch's own updated copy) opens a PR for it -- that PR's first-head check runs are the real-world test. Recording as 'routed', not 'done', until that is checked.
